instruction.text: Match each Spice Girl to their nickname.

feedback.finish: The Spice Girls rose to fame in the 1990s and are the best-selling girl group of all time. They are known for their catchy dance pop musical style.

instruction.text: Drag the Beatles into the empty box.

finish.text: The popularity of the Spice Girls has been compared to the Beatlemania of the 1960s. They both had large impacts on more than just music at the time, also influencing fashion and young people.
